flow.scope: New repair requires unchanged physical DEF bridge, regenerated old-tool guides, independent retained-cell proof and fresh route/RCX/STA. No previous candidate acceptance is transferred.

streamout.scope: Fresh clone-single-20260924 streamout only; no inherited timing, DRC, density or LVS acceptance
